label: Loop becomes the igr plugin skill
why: Baseline: /igr:ticket start|finish with the progress band, moved out of ~/.claude/skills.

label: Trivial changes skip codex
why: A change that needs no design and nothing for codex to check is edited, pushed and reviewed in-session, with no codex round trips.

label: Loop runs on tk
why: SKILL.md and loop.md now call the tk plumbing CLI (added in 141bb05) for the ticket lifecycle instead of the session doing each step by hand.

label: Overengineering pass over every plan row
why: Extra design-phase check on each plan row (after efd9e52). Meant to shrink the plan: costs in design, should save in develop and review.

label: Rejected simpler options need measured reasons
why: Each plan row names the simplest alternative with a measured-or-guessed reason; a guessed reason means measure or take the simpler option. More measuring in design.

label: Two independent passes for judgment findings
why: Review, bot and CI findings on the judgment track get two independent codex passes before a fix. Mechanical findings go in one brief.

label: Behaviour change mid-PR reruns all reviews
why: Any behaviour change inside a PR reruns the reviews on the full PR diff.

label: Clear codex between plan steps, short tool output
why: Codex is cleared between plan steps, effort is set per step, tests get timeouts, tool output is kept short.

label: DB and integration tests run in hosted CI
why: Database and integration tests run in hosted CI, locally only to diagnose. Less local test running and output.

label: KISS pass over the whole design
why: One more pass over the full design before the approval report. Adds a pass, aims to cut the design.

label: Read related tickets before the plan
why: The plan starts by reading related tickets, and a drift check runs at every checkpoint.

label: Resume mode and /clear handoffs
why: The session is cleared and resumed from a checkpoint at approval, at PR-ready and between PRs, so later phases stop carrying the design conversation.

label: Independent briefs carry the measuring commands
why: Codex re-measured from scratch because the brief named what to measure but not how; with the commands it stops rebuilding the method.

label: tk go starts or resumes a ticket
why: One shell command launches the ticket worktree at start or resume.
